newsitem.title: UK: Hays buys Inkhold to expand UK business mail.
newsitem.headline: Hays buys Inkhold to expand UK business mail.

text.p: Distribution and staff recruitment group Hays Plc said on Monday it is to expand its UK business mail operations with the purchase of Inkhold Limited, the holding company of ICS Corporation, for 65 million stg in cash.
The acquisition will, before integration costs, enhance earnings immediately, said Hays.

"There will be substantial benefits from integrating ICS into our commercial core activities," said Hays executive chairman Ronnie Frost. "The acquisition will broaden the range of services and customers and provide a strong platform to expand into Europe."
ICS provides early morning delivery services via a national depot network handling some 800,000 items a night. ICS went to Inkhold in a management buy-out in January last year.
The buy-out company Inkhold made an operating profit of 3.5 million stg on turnover of 58.6 million stg in the 11-1/2 months to end December 1995.
